units.source_text: 宣旨这个女儿，以前曾经在桐壶上皇御前伺候，源氏公子见过几次。

en.t: This daughter of the imperial secretary had once served before the retired Emperor Kiritsubo, and Prince Genji had seen her several times.

units.source_text: 但此次重见，觉得她消瘦得多了。

en.t: But when he saw her again this time, he felt that she had grown much thinner.

units.source_text: 那住宅也荒芜不堪，只是广大还似旧时。

en.t: The residence too had fallen into terrible neglect, though its spaciousness was still as it had been in former days.

units.source_text: 庭中古木参天，阴气逼人，不知她在这里如何过日子的。

en.t: In the garden, ancient trees towered toward the sky and a gloomy chill pressed in; he could not imagine how she passed her days there.

units.source_text: 然而这个人的模样很可爱，花信年华，桃李芳姿，

en.t: Yet she herself was very lovely, in the bloom of youth, with the fresh beauty of peach and plum blossoms,

units.source_text: 使源氏公子看了难于舍弃。

en.t: so that once Prince Genji saw her, he found it hard to leave her behind.

units.source_text: 便同她说笑：“我舍不得你远行，很想接你到我那里去，不知你意下如何？”

en.t: He therefore spoke to her half in jest: “I cannot bear to let you go so far away. I would very much like to bring you to my place. What do you think?”

units.source_text: 这女子想道：“若得在这个人身边侍候，我这不幸之身也有福了。”

en.t: The woman thought, “If I could serve at this man’s side, even my unfortunate life would be blessed.”

units.source_text: 她默默地仰望源氏公子。

en.t: She silently looked up at Prince Genji.
